svg.title: Madagascar interlock network
svg.text: 32 firms in 11 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 172 firms, 457 interlocks, 12 components (largest 140). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 57 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
